verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents export options (PPTX, PDF, HTML, handoff bundles to Claude Code) suggesting some open-format portability, but a hands-on community report shows a user was locked out of all their Claude Design projects/history after unsubscribing, directly contradicting the ability to export and leave freely; Anthropic staff acknowledged this as a bug to fix, confirming the underlying files are HTML/CSS/JS but admitting the export-on-exit flow was broken at the time. missing for 10: a documented full account/data export (chats, projects, assets) independent of Claude Design's design-file exports, and confirmation the unsubscribe lockout bug was actually resolved.
